text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's finally here—the Arima Kinen. I swear, it's like a carnival here.
choice_data_list: It sounds like your phone is part of the carnival too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm sorry. My phone is ringing non-stop. I'm receiving a ton of messages today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I checked it just now, and there were dozens.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: They're all supportive messages from old folks who have just learned how to text.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Many of them are very short and full of typos, like "I wilk be ther. Good lick."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: At the end, they all write the name of their shopping district. Even the folks in Kokura sent me messages.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Their support is what led me here. I'm really grateful.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Although, I'm still a bit too embarrassed to say that to their faces.
choice_data_list: You can repay them by winning the race.
You can repay them by winning the race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute! That's a lot more than just saying thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But… I guess a sourpuss like me needs to do that much, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If I win this race today, do you think I can become the main character?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Do you think I'll earn the right to say, "I can shine as bright as Teio"?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That was quick. You're so confident, as usual.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But today, I accept that confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If I want to get good results today, I'll probably have to do more than just my best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For Nice Nature, the Arima Kinen and its strong lineup of runners from each generation is a huge challenge to take on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But still!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …I will!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Uhh, this part makes me the most nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan, it's on. Let this race decide who is the faster between us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Of course! I won't pull any punches!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, those two…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And neither shall I. I'll win with elegance… and with grace.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Mejiro McQueen debuted before me. As expected from the prestigious Mejiro family, she's an excellent stayer.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I don't have to be all fancy. I'll race hard and snatch victory with mud-covered hands!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Mejiro Ryan. Like McQueen, she's from the Mejiro family and my senior. She's both cheerful and powerful.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Why is this place full of dazzling stars? I guess that's only natural for Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But wouldn't it be so exciting if the underdog won?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I did all I could do. All that's left is to win on this big stage…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And repay all the people rooting for me!
